items.description: Leak detection and moisture measurement for the kitchen sink supply leak, incl. technician labour and call-out
items.rationale: Insured peril is escape of water (2.4.2), and leak detection is necessary to locate the source (7.1.7(e)). Reference Case 21 shows a similar kitchen leak detection flat rate at t >= 229, and the work here is comparable in scope (full day, two technicians, moisture measurement included).

items.description: Freeing, repair and re-insulation of the leaking kitchen sink supply pipe, incl. replacement copper section
items.rationale: Direct repair of the affected pipe (2.4.2, 7.1.5, 7.1.7(a)(c)), including necessary removal and reinstallation of lagging. Reference Case 21 (similar kitchen pipe repair) gives t between 117 and 158 for freeing the pipe, and 157–220 for repair and replacement. This line combines both, so t should be at the upper end of that range.
Policy 7.1.7(f) allows one travel/call-out charge per contractor per invoice. Reference Case 21 shows t >= 76 for vehicle costs for similar work.

items.description: Drying of the kitchen floor and wall base, incl. condensation dryer
items.rationale: Drying of affected areas is necessary and covered (7.1.7(b)), and the description and photo confirm the affected parts. Reference Case 21 gives t between 20 and 148 for drying of kitchen floor and wall base, so use the upper end for a full week of drying.
